messages:
incident-bot: Paging: HIGH auth anomaly detected from edge proxy (spike of 401s + headers with tokens in logs) — severity P1. https://alerts.internal/6000009999 :rotating_light:
oncall-sre: I'm on it, pulling traces now. moving to #incident-bridge.
Kim (SRE): Joining bridge in 2m. Can someone start containment? Suggest: block source CIDR 198.51.100.0/24 on WAF.
raj-patel (sec): Acknowledge. Adding WAF rule now. Also preparing key rotation plan for implicated svcacct.
maria-g (eng): Which service/logs show exposure — staging or prod?
oncall-sre: Prod edge access logs. Saw partial auth headers in request logs to /v1/generate, sample (redacted): `Bearer sk-prod-abc...` - removing full tokens.
sec-bot: Evidence bundle created: sec-evidence-6000009999. Collecting log slices to s3://sec-evidence/6000009999 (read-only).
legal-ops: Legal hold placed on all artifacts. Do not purge or modify logs except via forensics process.
support-lead: Any confirmed customer impact? We have a high-volume EU customer on the affected edge.
eng-prod: Initial: token replay attempts observed against generation endpoints, but no confirmed successful data access. Downstream 401s causing retries.
Kim (SRE): Immediate plan: 1) block offending CIDR, 2) revoke implicated service token(s), 3) rotate keys for svc-prod-1, 4) issue scoped temporary creds and update deployments.
raj-patel (sec): Revoked svc-prod-1 token: `rbac revoke --service svc-prod-1 --reason "suspected leak 6000009999"` — command completed.
oncall-sre: WAF rule in place; seeing ~85% reduction in anomalous traffic.
maria-g (eng): Kicking rolling restart of edge proxies to clear KV caches that might still contain leaked tokens.
support-lead: Drafting customer note. Holding send until sec confirms rotation complete.
legal-ops: Also creating incident ticket with retention flags, copying Compliance.
eng-prod: Post-rotate telemetry: no successful authenticated replays after T+10m. Continuing watch.
Kim (SRE): Handoff to night oncall @ops-rotations in 30m. Documenting all steps in the incident runbook: https://wiki.internal/incidents/6000009999
ops-rotations: Taking over monitoring. Will keep bridge open 2h and run verification checks (token replay sweep, auth metric baselines).
raj-patel (sec): Follow-up task: rotate KMS keys used to encrypt logs pulled by the leaking process and rotate service principals that had access. Scheduling maintenance window.
support-lead: Notified customer contact: "No evidence of data exfil; tokens rotated; we are monitoring." Updating support ticket now.
legal-ops: Preparing notification decision matrix; will advise if regulator notification required.
oncall-sre: Closing immediate mitigation checklist. Creating postmortem stub and assigning owner Kim (SRE). ETA initial draft: 24h.
incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2. Please add any missing artifacts to sec-evidence-6000009999. :white_check_mark:
